description: Completed synthetic sampler-mismatch stress test; real measurements, one seed per method.

setup.noise: Fixed delta = 0.02 * initial_weight * Normal(0,1), added to current sampler weights; trainer and evaluation weights unperturbed.
setup.objective: REINFORCE with detached importance weights, no PPO clipping; binary correctness mapped to -1/+1 before within-prompt mean subtraction.
setup.normalization: Original generated-token count, including tokens rejected by IcePop.
setup.evaluation: 64 held-out questions at steps 0,20,...,280 and after update 300, using clean weights.
setup.training_step_index: 0-based rollout/update index 0..299; each training reward precedes its optimizer update.

limitations: One seed; trajectories diverge across methods. No statistical uncertainty estimate.
SC+TIS versus TIS-only zeros only the SC correction; IcePop additionally changes weighting and uses the native logprob path.
The top-k SC tail is an approximation. These runs do not test SC+IcePop.
Late training has heavy response truncation; retained verifier reward is not evidence of healthy generation.
Learning runs use the feature implementation before its upstream rebase/merge; PR-tree regression validation is separate.
